whatIs: Blocks is a collection of interface blocks for React built with shadcn/ui and Tailwind: login screens, tables, sidebars, forms, command menus, and AI chats, among others, spread across 13 categories.
It's a good fit when you already use shadcn/ui and want to start from complete sections instead of building them component by component.
uses: Setting up an app's login and sign-up with a ready-made block.
Building a dashboard with a sidebar, stats cards, and tables.
Adding an AI chat interface to a project without designing it from scratch.
caveats: It's designed for projects with React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui; outside that stack you have to adapt it.
Blocks are added with the shadcn CLI through the @blocks-so registry, so you need shadcn initialized in the project.
Because they're copied into your code, future updates to the block don't reach you on their own.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; there's no paid plan.
idealFor: Projects with shadcn/ui that need ready-to-copy sections.
